summary: Gelteq Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval and closing of the second tranche of a debt financing with an institutional investor. The aggregate principal amount is up to $3.5 million across two tranches; the first tranche of $1.0 million (net of $150,000 OID) closed on May 7, 2026, and the second tranche of $2.5 million (net of $375,000 OID) closed on June 26, 2026. Each tranche issued a convertible promissory note convertible into ordinary shares at 93% of the lowest daily VWAP during the five trading days preceding measurement. The financing is a structured capital return through convertible debt, not a standard reorganization or buyback. The board recommended approval, required under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d). Watch for dilution risk from the conversion feature and potential shareholder overhang.
